messages:
alejandra: quick heads-up — i'm opening a docs PR to add a migration appendix for private/VPC installs. it bundles: a short MTU troubleshooting note, an example PKCS#11 HSM config, a minimal JS SDK offline-proxy snippet, and a checksum step for air-gapped bundles. need 1-2 reviewers.

mike: can you drop the port matrix change in that PR too? customers keep asking which ports are required for the installer vs runtime.

alejandra: yep adding a compact port table (eg. 443, 2379, 6443, 50051, 10250) and a note about ephemeral NAT for dedicated egress. keeping it one page, not a full matrix.

jin: heads up — one of the old links to the HSM vendor guide is 404. i'll paste the replacement in a sec. also, MTU note — pls include guidance for 1400 vs 1500 and symptom: detached tcp streams, long handshake times.

emily: i can validate the checksum step on our air-gapped lab. what checksum algo are you using? sha256?

alejandra: yes sha256. proposed preflight snippet:

```
# on build host
sha256sum redwood-offline-bundle.tar.gz > redwood-offline-bundle.tar.gz.sha256
# on target sealed site (after transport)
sha256sum -c redwood-offline-bundle.tar.gz.sha256
```

emily: perfect — i'll run that on sealed-site-qa1 and report differences.

jin: replacement HSM link: https://hsm-vendor.example.com/linux-pkcs11-guide — will add as reference. also adding PKCS#11 minimal config example:

```ini
# /etc/redwood/hsm.conf
pkcs11_library = /usr/lib/libpkcs11.so
slot_label = "redwood-hsm-slot"
pin = "****"
use_soft_token = false
```

mike: can you also add a troubleshooting subsection: "pkcs11 load errors" with common fixes (permissions, incorrect lib path, missing dependency)? small bullets.

alejandra: yep. i'll add quick commands to verify libs: `ldd /usr/lib/libpkcs11.so` and `strace -e open` example.

ops-tim: FYI we tested the installer behind an MTU=1400 path earlier this week. two notes: 1) gossip/etcd restore can stall if chunking assumptions are 1500+, 2) kube-apiserver websockets may need `--max-request-bytes` tuning. i'll add the reproducer steps to the PR comments.

emily: also saw a broken example in the JS SDK doc for the proxy; the snippet uses deprecated `rejectUnauthorized`. we should use modern fetch + agent. proposing a minimal snippet for offline proxy auth:

```js
// minimal node fetch with a proxy agent (example)
const fetch = require('node-fetch');
const HttpsProxyAgent = require('https-proxy-agent');
const agent = new HttpsProxyAgent('http://proxy.local:3128');

await fetch('https://redwood.example/api/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  agent,
  headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_KEY}` },
  body: JSON.stringify({ prompt: 'hi' })
});
```

jin: good — add a note about DOCKER_BUILDKIT and proxy env vars for the offline build process. some customers forget `no_proxy`.

alejandra: thanks all. plan: i'll open PR in ~30m, include the mtU repro from ops-tim, the hsm link, the checksum snippet, the JS SDK snippet, and the compact port checklist. tagging @mike @jin for review.

docs-bot: CI started for branch: docs/private-vpc-migration-appendix (build #452) :construction_worker:

mike: i'll review this afternoon, focusing on port list and the quick commands. if emily validates checksum ok i'll merge. :thumbsup:

emily: running checksum test now on sealed-site-qa1, will post results here in ~20m.
